caveats: Data is sourced directly from Overture places (commercial and crowd sources: Meta, Foursquare, Microsoft); records are not verified and per-feature confidence varies. Verify before operational use and check Overture's usage guidelines.
name: hot_overture_ven_emergency_facilities
notes:
Emergency and essential-health facilities for the Caracas area of Venezuela
(bounding box 67.09W-66.65W, 10.28N-10.64N), captured for the M 7.5 earthquake response.

Includes hospitals, emergency rooms, medical centres, pharmacies, fire, police, and ambulance/EMS services.

Sourced from the Overture Maps places theme (Meta, Foursquare, Microsoft, AllThePlaces). This data is not from OpenStreetMap and complements the OSM-based exports.

Event: M 7.5 Earthquake, west of Caracas.

- Source: [Overture Maps](https://overturemaps.org/)
- Part of HOT disaster response exports on HDX by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)

organization.name: hot
organization.title: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
organization.description:
**For up-to-the-minute exports from OpenStreetMap in a variety of formats for GPS and GIS, visit http://export.hotosm.org**

Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) acts as a bridge between the traditional humanitarian responders and the OpenStreetMap Community. HOT works both remotely and physically in countries to assist the collection of geographic data, usage of that information and training others in OpenStreetMap.
